audit.whatIsWrong: This side's chart read Skill, Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Skill, Vayne, Vayne — it disagrees with the already-audited Ryze side (Vayne, Ryze, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Vayne) on four of seven rows.
audit.why: The mirror is authority per the run rules and mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement introduced here. Its mechanical basis is sound: Flux (E) is a 3.5s cooldown that turns Rune Prison from a slow into a root, and Tumble only moves 300 units, so it cannot clear the cage.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Ryze, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Vayne — restated from Vayne's side, rows proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] and spikes[2] both called the first item Vayne's window; the mirror gives that row to Ryze, and neither layer said why.
audit.why: Arcane Mastery scales Ryze's damage off bonus mana, so his first item raises every spell's damage, while Vayne's Blade of the Ruined King spike is a duel item he can refuse with a 9-11s Rune Prison. Vayne's real spike here is two items plus Final Hour.
audit.corrected: First item is his; two items and Final Hour are yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every line treated Rune Prison as a flat root. Riot's own text makes it a slow that only becomes a root when Flux is already on the target — the ordering was never stated.
audit.why: Rune Prison damages and slows; 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' Spell Flux is on 3.5s at rank 1, so the tell is E-then-W. Tumbling out before the orb lands leaves you slowed, not caged.
audit.corrected: Flux first, cage second — Tumble out before the orb lands and W is only a slow.

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Ryze contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Ryze has one spell at 1 and Overload is a 1000-range line — sidestep it and your autos out-damage him. Take that trade.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Ryze's Rune Prison is down.
edits.after: Rune Prison arrives; Flux turns it into a root and Tumble's 300 units won't clear the cage. Give ground.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ryze must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His rotation is online: Flux, Overload, then the cage out-damages your three autos. Farm at range and wait for 4.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Rune Prison's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item stacks mana into every spell, so Overload outgrows your Blade spike. Fight only on his 11s W.

edits.before: At 2 your DPS keeps out-trading his short-range poke.
edits.after: At 2 Flux into Rune Prison roots you past Tumble.

edits.before: Level 3 your Tumble and W let you walk him down.
edits.after: Level 3 his full rotation out-damages three autos.

edits.before: First item your true damage shreds his low health faster than he pokes.
edits.after: First item his mana-stacked Overload out-trades your Blade of the Ruined King.

edits.before: Yours: Ryze is immobile and short-ranged for a mage, so your Silver Bolts (W) DPS and Tumble (Q) let you walk him down. He can Rune Prison (W) root you, but sidestep it and he has no other peel.
edits.after: Contested: Ryze is immobile, but Spell Flux (E) on 3.5s into Rune Prison (W) roots you — Tumble moves 300 units and will not clear the cage. Trade while W is on its 11 seconds.

edits.before: Back to you: with Blade of the Ruined King online, Silver Bolts true damage shreds his low-health frame far faster than his Overload (Q) poke chips you. Dodge Rune Prison and all-in.
edits.after: His: mana stacking makes Overload (Q) chunk you from 1000 range, and Rune Prison answers your all-in every 11s. Farm it — Flux first means the cage roots you, not slows.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ryze's whole rotation lands point-blank — Flux, cage, Overload.
